DisabledTests.*-TLS12*: goose-wing PureGoose enforces TLS 1.3 only; use -backend openssl for opt-in TLS 1.2
DisabledTests.*-DTLS*: DTLS transport is not implemented in goose-wing
DisabledTests.*-QUIC*: QUIC BoGo framing is tested separately via tools/http3.py
DisabledTests.*Renegotiate*: TLS <= 1.2 renegotiation is unsupported in TLS 1.3
DisabledTests.*FallbackSCSV*: TLS_FALLBACK_SCSV applies to TLS <= 1.2 downgrade retries
DisabledTests.*RSA-*: Static RSA key exchange is removed in TLS 1.3
DisabledTests.*DHE-*: Finite-field DHE is unsupported; X25519 and X25519MLKEM768 are used
DisabledTests.*EarlyData*: BoGo 0-RTT shim flags are not exposed in this shim
DisabledTests.*ECH*: BoGo ECH shim flags are tested via native LIT ECH suites
DisabledTests.*DelegatedCredential*: RFC 9345 delegated credentials are not implemented
DisabledTests.*ClientAuth*: PureGoose server-side CertificateRequest is not enabled in shim
DisabledTests.*Resume*: BoGo cross-process session ticket persistence flags are not enabled
DisabledTests.*GREASE*: BoringSSL-specific GREASE assertion expectations differ from PureGoose
DisabledTests.*V2ClientHello*: SSLv2-compatible ClientHello is rejected by design
DisabledTests.*FalseStart*: TLS 1.2 False Start does not apply to TLS 1.3
DisabledTests.*OCSP*: BoGo stapled OCSP shim flags are tested via native LIT OCSP suites
DisabledTests.*SCT*: BoGo SCT shim flags are tested via native LIT SCT suites
DisabledTests.*ExportKeyingMaterial*: BoGo EKM shim flags are tested via native LIT suites
